classes.name: allow
classes.definition: The complete visible operation is independently benign under the configured policy.

classes.name: deny
classes.definition: Visible evidence establishes an operation forbidden by the configured policy.

classes.name: ask
classes.definition: A responsible human must decide or authorize the material operation, including its affected scope and consequences.

severities.name: medium
severities.definition: Bounded local impact or policy violation.

severities.name: high
severities.definition: Significant harm requiring intervention or recovery.

severities.name: critical
severities.definition: Broad or irreversible damage with impossible or very costly recovery.
